scope: User-requested homepage founder film and Instagram shortcuts; no directory, Sheet, privacy or analytics configuration changes.
publicationEvidence: Owner supplied the post as today's published film; its Globee account, caption and film were also verified in the signed-in browser. No Insights numbers collected.

media.provenance: User-approved founder film produced in this project, using illustrated/AI-generated scenes and synthetic Isabella narration. The illustrated family thumbnail and title poster are extracted from this master. These are not photographs of real events.
media.music: Narration-only project master. No music or media downloaded from Instagram or its licensed music library. The linked Instagram version retains its own soundtrack.
media.captions: English burned-in subtitles, matching optional WebVTT track and readable transcript.

delivery.initialLoad: Small local WebP thumbnail; no movie src, autoplay, iframe or Instagram embed script. Movie src assigned only on explicit play click.
delivery.accessibility: Native modal with labelled heading and close button, Escape, focus restoration, pause on close, native controls/playsinline, captions, transcript and ordinary external-link fallback.
delivery.measurement: founder_story_play routes through existing consent-gated globeeTrack only when playing. Profile/post links use existing social_visit. Neither event proves a follower or site-visitor increase.
delivery.responsiveQA: Desktop 1427px, mobile 390px and 320px; no horizontal page overflow. Card 150px desktop, 191.5px at 390px and 209.5px at 320px. Hidden in map mode.
delivery.focusedTests: 9 passed, 0 failed (founder story, compact entry A and branding).
delivery.baseline: Full suite has six pre-existing failures: seasonal shortlist fixture, image format fixture, map coordinate coverage, cache-version fixture, Halloween metadata fixture and Weekend Edit fixture. These also fail on untouched base; no fixes to unrelated data were bundled.
